mapper.select: SELECT id, event_key, stock_id, price, event_time, received_at, source, sequence_no, processing_status, discard_reason, origin_type, event_time_ns, provider, feed, accepted_sequence, processed_at, baseline_reason FROM quote_events WHERE event_key = #{eventKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE quote_events SET processing_status = 'PROCESSED', discard_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{eventId} AND processing_status = 'RECEIVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_key, stock_id, price, event_time, received_at, source, sequence_no, processing_status, discard_reason, origin_type FROM quote_events WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND origin_type = 'REAL' ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
